name: Two-Pass Lighting and Shading
definition: A two-pass drawing algorithm: Pass 1 (CPU) computes illumination inside the cloud (transmittance/scattering) when light source changes; Pass 2 (GPU) renders the projection using pre-computed data.
summary: Two-Pass Lighting and Shading decouples light transport from compositing by pre-computing illumination in a voxel grid, enabling real-time rendering of complex volumes.
